summary: TAT Technologies Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K supplementing its proxy statement for the upcoming Annual General Meeting on September 8, 2026, in Tel Aviv. The filing proposes clarifications and amendments to the company's Compensation Policy, including revised caps on annual cash bonuses for the CEO (150% of base salary, reduced from 200%) and CFO (120%, reduced from 150%), a 75% minimum threshold for bonus entitlement, and an equity compensation cap for the CEO not exceeding $5 million or 400% of base salary. It also clarifies that the board chairman is not an executive officer. This is a routine supplemental AGM disclosure with no special-situation event, so no deal terms apply.
